items.value:
As SCHOLAR_DATA,
finish a level in hide and seek mode while only target Baldi with the projectiles
without missing a shot. (Or just throw it towards him once.)

Use up an item that is an playable character
exclusive alternative to An Apple for Baldi.
The Richest Robot in the School
As the Thinker, accumulate up to a total of 25,000 YTPs!

As the Thinker,
collect 9 or more total notebooks in a single floor
without using the P. Ability: Intelligent Thinking.

As the Backpacker,
finish hide and seek mode without filling up the inventory
that much just to maintain speed. (Inside of the pitstop does not count!)

As the Tinkereer, successfully fool Baldi
with an invention that is meant to look like a student.

As the Test Subject,
finish hide and seek mode without overflowing time and space!
Fresh out of the Delta Time

Obtain a really really ridiculous
to obtain sticker from a fresh sticker pack.
As the Magical Student, send a rulebreaking character to detention.
